adultGuide.title: Archive Drawer Resolution Adult Guide: ____________________.
bullets: Adult-led setup: place the archive drawer, blank slips, pencils, and one resolution card on the table before the paper-only work begins: ____________________.
Adult-led framing: keep every loose thread, last choice, changed feeling, closing image, leftover question, next-story seed, and archive drawer label fictional: ____________________.
Adult-led order: move from loose thread to last choice, changed feeling, closing image, leftover question, next-story seed, and archive drawer label: ____________________.
Adult-led support: let the writer write or dictate short paper lines while the adult keeps the archive drawer sorted: ____________________.
Adult-led safety: use pretend names, broad made-up places, and invented actions instead of personal facts or exact identifiers: ____________________.
Adult-led finish: reread the paper-only resolution plan, choose the next-story seed, and write the archive drawer label: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Loose Thread Sort: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, loose thread slip, blank page, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult opens the archive drawer and points to the loose thread blank: ____________________.
The writer names one fictional loose thread still waiting on paper: ____________________.
The adult asks which earlier paper note the loose thread connects to: ____________________.
The writer writes the loose thread on the slip and places it at the front: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: This resolution plan starts with the loose thread: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Last Choice Link: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, loose thread slip, last choice slip, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult rereads the loose thread and points to the last choice blank: ____________________.
The writer names the fictional last choice that answers part of the loose thread: ____________________.
The adult asks how the last choice links back to the paper plan: ____________________.
The writer writes the last choice link and slides it behind the loose thread: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: The last choice links the loose thread to this answer: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Changed Feeling Check: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, last choice slip, changed feeling slip, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult places the last choice slip beside the changed feeling blank: ____________________.
The writer names one changed feeling for the fictional character after the last choice: ____________________.
The adult asks what paper line makes that changed feeling clear: ____________________.
The writer writes the changed feeling check and keeps it with the last choice: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: The changed feeling after the last choice is: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Closing Image Pass: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, changed feeling slip, closing image slip, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult rereads the changed feeling and points to the closing image blank: ____________________.
The writer invents one paper-only closing image that fits the resolution plan: ____________________.
The adult asks what the closing image helps the reader imagine at the end: ____________________.
The writer writes the closing image and places it after the changed feeling: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: The closing image for this fictional resolution is: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Leftover Question Note: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, closing image slip, leftover question note, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult sets the closing image beside the leftover question blank: ____________________.
The writer names one gentle leftover question that can remain for a next-story seed: ____________________.
The adult asks which part belongs in this resolution and which part waits: ____________________.
The writer writes the leftover question note and marks it for the next-story seed: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: The leftover question waiting for a next-story seed is: ____________________.

resolutionRoutines.title: Archive Drawer Label Close: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.materials: Archive drawer, finished slips, label strip, and pencil: ____________________.
steps: The adult rereads the loose thread, last choice, changed feeling, closing image, and leftover question: ____________________.
The writer chooses one next-story seed that grows from the leftover question: ____________________.
The adult asks what archive drawer label will help sort this paper-only resolution: ____________________.
The writer writes the next-story seed and archive drawer label, then the adult files the slips: ____________________.
resolutionRoutines.adultWrapLine: The archive drawer label closes the resolution as: ____________________.
